segments.tts: Ever wondered what a puck does all day? Today: a day at work with Pucky!
5 a.m. – I wake up in the freezer. Minus ten Celsius. Cozy.
Fun fact: frozen pucks bounce less.
Then warm-ups. Clubby slaps me around. It's fine. We're friends.
Partners. Back in my day, pucks didn't complain.
Game time! Hardest shot ever: 108.8 miles per hour – Zdeno Chara, 2012. I felt that.
And then you hit my mask. Every. Single. Day.
After a couple of minutes I get too warm, so the linesman swaps me for a frozen buddy.
The NHL even tested pucks that change colour when they warm up!
Then back to the freezer, ice-cold. That's why I'm so cool!
